messages:
Nina (CS): Heads-up: client 'Acorn Lane' onboarding hit intermittent P95 spikes on chat generate during peak. renewal in ~60 days, they reported slower responses and cost drift. Need quick ops + eng recs.
Owen (Solutions): saw that in heatmap, thanks. Any sample requests?
Nina (CS): sample intent is invoice extraction + summary. one example: `summarize invoice, extract PO and total` 70 tokens typical. P95 went from ~1.2s to ~3.6s for some bursts; cost +15% month-over-month.
Tariq (SE): what model/region?
Nina (CS): redwood/gpt-large on hosted eu-west, FP16 default. no quant yet.
OpsBot: auto-insight: traffic burst correlates with 10:00-11:00 PT cron jobs. Suggest: enable prefix KV cache and consider int8 quant pilot. Estimated cost reduction ~20% and P95 improvement ~25% on test traces.
Lina (Eng): proposed plan: 1) Canary int8 variant for short requests (<1500 tokens) at 10% traffic; keep FP16 for long requests. 2) Add regional fallback to us-west for eu-west capacity spikes. 3) Turn on KV prefix caching for repeated invoice prompts. 4) Evaluate quality on curated 250-sample set.
Owen (Solutions): can we make rollback conditions explicit for the customer?
Nina (CS): yes: auto rollback if >1% quality regression on extraction accuracy or >12% error rate increase within 24h. We'll also capture customer feedback form after 48h.
Tariq (SE): pilot implementation notes:
```
- model variant: redwood/gpt-large:int8-canary
- routing: if region==eu-west AND p99_latency>2.5s -> route to us-west (policy: eu-fallback-us)
- traffic split: 90% fp16, 10% int8 for requests <1500 tokens
- caching: enable KV-prefix for invoice templates
- eval set: s3://redwood-evals/acornlane-invoice-250.csv
- logging: token-diff + extraction-accuracy metric
```
Lina (Eng): we'll tag traces with `acornlane-canary-6789012345`. also ensure streaming contract unchanged. need SE to verify client reconnect behavior on fallback.
Owen (Solutions): I'll draft the customer-facing pilot note with expected metrics and rollback SLA. Nina, want a short slide + bullet list?
Nina (CS): yes please. include expected metrics: cost down ~20%, P95 down ~25%, quality delta within +/-1% on extraction.
OpsBot: pre-run eval on 150 samples: precision drop 0.3% (within noise), flagged 4 edge cases (dates formatting). Recommend manual review before full rollout. Link: https://internal.redwood/evals/6789012345
Tariq (SE): if extraction regressions show up, fallback for extractor endpoints only (use FP16) and continue int8 for summarization.
Nina (CS): I'll schedule 30-min kickoff with Acorn Lane CSM + Solutions tomorrow. Owen, please have pilot draft by EOD.
Owen (Solutions): will do. I'll include execution checklist and postback cadence.
Lina (Eng): Ops will monitor and run auto-eval at 48h and post results to this thread.
Nina (CS): thanks team. I'll capture customer feedback and 50 random prompt snapshots for manual QA after 48h. :white_check_mark:
